change_interpretations.engineering_summary: The controller must limit positive propulsion torque under elevated thermal load and log a derating diagnostic event. This introduces new verification needs for thermal load conditions and diagnostic logging.

assessments.reason: Test verifies pedal-to-torque response time (VCU-DR-01) unrelated to thermal derating. No thermal load conditions are exercised in the procedure.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for torque response timing.

assessments.reason: Test validates brake override priority (VCU-BRK-03) unrelated to thermal derating. No thermal load conditions are exercised.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for brake arbitration.

assessments.reason: Test involves high-load cases which may overlap with thermal load conditions. Previous evidence (92 ms) may no longer validate derated torque limits under thermal stress.
assessments.recommended_action: Re-check if high-load scenarios include thermal stress conditions and update torque limits accordingly.

assessments.reason: Test verifies brake command latency (VCU-BRK-03) unrelated to thermal derating. No thermal load conditions are exercised.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for brake latency.

assessments.reason: Test validates sensor failure response (VCU-DGN-04) unrelated to thermal derating. No thermal load conditions are exercised.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for sensor failure handling.

assessments.reason: Test verifies mode change logging (VCU-LOG-05) unrelated to thermal derating. No thermal load conditions are exercised.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for mode audit trail.

assessments.reason: Test explicitly mentions elevated thermal load and checks torque delivery under such conditions. The new requirement mandates derated torque limits and diagnostic logging, invalidating previous 'NOT RUN' status.
assessments.recommended_action: Update procedure to measure derated torque limits and verify diagnostic event logging under thermal load.

assessments.reason: Test references an unknown requirement (VCU-OLD-88). The new requirement adds a diagnostic event log under thermal load, which may or may not be covered by legacy diagnostics.
assessments.recommended_action: Clarify requirement linkage and verify if thermal derating events are included in legacy diagnostics.

assessments.reason: Test verifies mode-specific torque ramps (VCU-MOD-06) unrelated to thermal derating. No thermal load conditions are exercised.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for mode profile verification.

assessments.reason: Test validates pedal signal filtering (VCU-DR-02) unrelated to thermal derating. No thermal load conditions are exercised.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for signal filtering.

assessments.reason: Test verifies brake override priority (VCU-BRK-03) unrelated to thermal derating. No thermal load conditions are exercised.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for brake priority.

assessments.reason: Test verifies ECU wake-up timing unrelated to thermal derating. No thermal load conditions are exercised.
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed; test remains valid for platform startup.
